scripts.title: SyzenHub
scripts.features:
SyzenHub | Dead Shelter
Made this for Dead Shelter. Focused mostly on ESP + useful stuff so you can actually see everything clearly and play easier.
UI is simple, runs smooth, and doesn’t spam your screen.
Player ESP
Shows player name + distance
Health bar with color
Tracers (from top of screen)
Player counter at top
Only shows players on screen (clean look)
NPC ESP
Noob (Pawnshop)
Lenny (Blackmarket)
Grim Reaper
Shows distance + label
Zombie ESP
Works for multiple zombie types:
Normal
Tank
Police
Runner
Cave
Dynamite
Ranged
Adjustable distance
Toggle each zombie type individually
Item ESP
Weapons (M4A1, Shotgun, Glock, etc.)
Ammo types
Keycards (Red, Blue, Green)
Loot (Diamond, Silver Bar, Deadbucks, etc.)
Auto refresh system (keeps items updated)
Other Stuff
Clean UI using Luna UI
Key system included
Config save/load
Optimized loops 
Notes
still updating
might add more features later

scripts.title: SPYMM for DS
scripts.features:
- Items
  - Bring Items
    - Bring Selected Items
    - Bring All Items
  - Item Whitelist (Select the Items u want)
  - Weld Control
    - Unweld Before Bring (Turn this ON!)
    - Reweld After Bring
    - Scan Welded Items (IDK)
- Visuals
  - ESP
    - Item ESP (Highlight does not work)
    - Monster ESP (same as Item ESP)
    - Max Distance (up to 2000 st)
    - Text Size (up to 24 px)
  - Enviroment
    - No Fog
    - Full Bright
- Combat
  - Kill Aura (does work on very close distance)
    - Attack Delay (up to 1 sec)
    - Damage Per Hit (up to 999999)
- Player
  - Movement
    - Walkspeed (up to 300 st/s)
    - Jump Power (up to 500)
    - Infinite Jump (Keyb: Space)
    - No Clip (Keyb: N)
  - Camera & Survival
    - Custom FOV (up to 120)

Have fun!
